# Roshan Trivedi

> Personal site of Roshan Trivedi, an identity security product leader in Bengaluru, India. He works on privileged access management (PAM), credential and secrets management, Zero Standing Privilege, non-human identity, and keeping a person in the loop when AI agents use real tools. All case studies are written without employer, client or other confidential data.

## Start here
- [About](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/about/): background, how he works, where he can help
- [Résumé](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/resume/): roles, certifications with status and verification links
- [Case studies](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/case-studies/): 20 privacy-safe case studies on privileged access, NHI, governance and agentic AI

## Research and labs
- [Who Approved That? (free book)](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/book/): 138 pages on human approval for AI agent tool calls, 210 scripted checks
- [HumanGate MCP lab](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/mcp-lab-case-study/): an approval gateway for MCP tool calls and what held under testing
- [Securing India's National Exams](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/secure-india-exams/): a Zero Trust reference architecture for exam security
- [Credential tiering self-check](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/tools/tier-check/)

## Flagship: AI Governance Lab
- [AI Governance Lab](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/ai-governance-lab/): 13 rounds and 164 cases testing whether AI governance controls hold, on made-up data; every guess hashed before the code.
- [All 164 cases](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/ai-governance-lab/cases/): each case with the guess, the result and what it shows.
- [Mac record](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/ai-governance-lab/mac/): every command run on a MacBook Air, with output.
- [What I got wrong](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/ai-governance-lab/what-i-got-wrong/): dated corrections, including the 25 Oct 2026 re-count of rounds 6, 7 and 9.
- [Does AI Governance Hold? (book, 69 pages)](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/assets/ai-governance-lab-book.pdf)
- [Who Approved That? (book, 138 pages)](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/book/)
- [Rounds five to thirteen (PDF, 74 pages)](https://roshantrivedi.co.in/assets/ai-governance-lab-addendum.pdf)
- [Code (MIT)](https://github.com/trivediroshan1-ui/ai-governance-lab): run it in a browser with GitHub Codespaces.
Stated limits: small models, made-up data, no real tenant, and the author wrote both the guesses and the code. Personal project; not employer work.
